label: Umbrella
depicts: Half circle umbrella canopy above one straight shaft ending in one curved hook handle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic rain umbrella with a vertical shaft and hooked handle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the leaning beach umbrella when the canopy should sit on an angled pole over a base.

label: Umbrella
depicts: Leaning beach umbrella canopy above one angled pole and one low ground base
use_when: Use when the interface wants an umbrella fixed to the ground at an angle instead of a handheld rain umbrella.
avoid_when: Do not use for the hook handled umbrella when the canopy should not sit on a low base with a leaning pole.

label: Vector Bezier
depicts: Bezier path with one top bar linking two top nodes and two lower branch nodes
use_when: Use when the interface wants the bezier cue to branch downward from a top handle bar into two lower nodes.
avoid_when: Do not use for the S path bezier or the square node frame when the icon should not reduce to one loose curve or one closed box.

label: Vector Bezier
depicts: Curved bezier path linking four square nodes across one loose S shaped line
use_when: Use when the interface wants the bezier cue to read as one flowing curve through several nodes.
avoid_when: Do not use for the branched top bar bezier or the closed square node frame when the path should stay one loose curve.

label: Vector Bezier
depicts: Square outline built from four corner nodes connected by four straight segments
use_when: Use when the interface wants the bezier cue to read as a closed square frame anchored by four corner nodes.
avoid_when: Do not use for the branched bezier or the S curve bezier when the icon should not open into branches or flowing curves.
